vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Benoit taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Benoit passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Benoit — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Benoit chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ava just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Hermann, Nathan, Chantal, Ava and Benoit met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Hermann, Nathan, Chantal, Ava, Benoit are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dmitri just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dmitri just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Anayo just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Benoit just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nathan, Dmitri, Chantal, Ava and Benoit met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Nathan, Chantal, Ava, Benoit are hurt.
🌿 Ground Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
SYSTEM: "That was... a lot. The producers say the ratings were historic. I don’t know what to do with that sentence."
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Benoit Lambert, 45 — a Baker. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Cold-Blooded, Green Thumb, Literally, War Cry.
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Dmitri — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Dmitri chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
Cold-blooded: your body budgets like an accountant. (-20% food need today)
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Dmitri Sokolov, 41 — an appliance repair tech. His hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Cold-Blooded.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
You fling a handful of grit into The Elder The Ugly Beast's eyes. It reels, clawing at its face — half-blind for 2 rounds. (Pocket Sand: attacks at disadvantage.)
The Elder The Ugly Beast shifts, seeking a clear lane.
Elder The Ugly Beast lashes at sand-ghosts near you. Missed. (pocket_sand)

🛡️ Reuben, Hinekura and Sergei met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Hinekura, Sergei are hurt.
